intro.text:
Threadsandarts.com has developed its privacy policy for ensuring fair practices. Below we enlist the types of information we collect and how we treat that information.
Threadsandarts.com is an advocate for fair practices and has developed its privacy policy based on fair practices. Following text details the information we collect from website visitors and our procedure for processing the collected information.

blocks.text: When a person visits our website, we don’t ask to reveal any personal information to us unless when they signup to receive our services or inquire about our products. In order to analyze trend and statistics, we receive and track the internet address of the domain used by the visitor while keeping the user anonymous.

Use of “cookies” enables us to customize your next visits to our website. Cookies are small data text files sent by a web site to your browser and can be stored on your computer’s hard drive (if your Web browser permits). Cookies help in facilitating and identifying the visitor on his next visit to our website. If you wish not to use cookies, you can change the “setting” in your browser to prompt you with an option to accept or reject cookies. We use cookies to improve our service on our website and use for retargeting campaigns aimed at showing our latest offers on our affiliate websites and different partner sponsors.

Collection of personal information on our website from visitors is on voluntary basis. Collected information in this process may include your first and last names, email address, cell phone numbers, city, country, user name and passwords etc, in case of creating your login area and providing you access to that area on our website. Collected personal information will not be sold to any third parties. The information may be shared with others on aggregated bases but we will not share your information which could later be linked to an individual.

Threadsandarts.com , do not and will not, at any time, request your credit card information, login name or password in any email or telephone communication. We are greatly concerned with the fraudulent identity thefts and other practices known as “phishing”. It is our priority to help and protect you by safeguarding all information.

In order to improve our service and website performance, we may collect information which is not personally identifiable. The purpose of collecting such information which cannot identify users is to assess trends, manage the website, track movement of visitors on the website, and to collect demographic information of all website visitors collectively. This information is utilized internally and is not shared with any other organization for commercial purposes.

We do everything possible to monitor and maintain strict content guidelines and use intelligent filter to filter non-appropriate, abusive, racial and adult words. We cannot be held liable for any offence, damage, injury or other legal infraction attributed to such content. Threadsandarts.com is an embroidery digitizing and vector designing service provider; we are not content provider.

We may use third-party advertising (like Google Adsense, AdRoll etc) to serve ads when you visit our Web site pages. Google, as a third party vendor, may use cookies to serve ads on our site. Google’s use of the DART cookie enables it to show ads based on their visit and interest in subject available on our site. If you would like to opt out of the DART cookie, check the method on Google ad and content network privacy policy.
Please note that these companies may use collected information (not including any of your personal details) about your visits to this and other web sites in order to provide advertisements of your interest.

We may disclose user or signer information when we have reason to believe that disclosing this information is necessary to identify, contact or bring legal action against someone who may be violating our policy or may be causing injury or interference, intentionally or unintentionally, to Threadsandarts.com’s rights or property, other of our users, or anyone else that could be harmed by such activities.

Our website contains linke to external websites which may or maynot be owned by Threadsandarts.com. Kindly be aware that we are not responsible for the practices related to privacy of such other sites. For more information, please read our statement on use of ads (above). We encourage our users to be aware when they leave our site, to read the privacy statements of each and every web site that collects personally identifiable information. This privacy statement applies solely to information collected by us.

We change our privacy policy from time to time and these changes are posted on the Privacy policy page of our website. It is recommended to check and revisit the changes to our web site’s privacy policy.

If you do not agree to our Privacy Policy as posted here on this website, please do not use this site or any services offered by this site. Your use of this site indicates acceptance of this privacy policy.

If you still have question about www.Threadsandarts.com’s privacy policy then please contact us using the email address mentioned for support or using the feedback form in contact us section.
